. This assay is used for identifying the
genes. Average coverage of the targeted region obtained  was around 500X.Genomic DNA was isolated from blood
sample using commercial kit according to manufacturer's instructions and the target regions of interest were amplified
using the Ampliseq™ BRCA Panel. Library preparation was performed using the Ion AmpliSeq™ Library Kit Plus. The
sequencing was performed on the GeneStudio S5plus. The FASTQ reads were aligned against the hg19 in the Torrent suite
software (v5.18.2). Variant calling was done using Ion Reporter (v5.20.2.0). The variants were annotated using Custom
Germline BRCA Assay Annotations v5.20 and ACMG guidelines was followed for variant classification.
